incident.summary: The deliberation selector existed and passed unit tests, but host/session maintenance could still promote a first-plausible architecture without first applying the selector. This allowed UAOS to be treated as a mandatory business gateway and left a stale same-task-id Financial rule in ENTRYPOINT after narrower router state was corrected.

root_cause: Deliberation was implemented as a pure selector but not made a fail-closed pre-mutation/pre-promotion host admission rule for material architecture/governance changes.
Closure verification was local to edited files/tests and did not require an authority-wide contradiction scan across ENTRYPOINT, session policy, task/router state and affected domain bindings.
The parent/child relationship was conflated with mandatory request routing; parent governance was incorrectly allowed to imply parent mediation of normal child business execution.

external_architecture_evidence.property_borrowed: control plane manages workload infrastructure while worker nodes run application workloads; management does not imply every workload request is proxied by the control plane
external_architecture_evidence.fit: supports UAOS as governance/control plane with direct domain work-plane execution
external_architecture_evidence.misfit: UAOS is conversational governance, not a Kubernetes scheduler; no process/network mechanics are copied

external_architecture_evidence.property_borrowed: supervisor starts/stops/monitors child processes while workers retain their own execution role
external_architecture_evidence.fit: supports parent supervision/upcall without parent becoming the child's normal message proxy
external_architecture_evidence.misfit: no OTP restart tree or process semantics are introduced

changes: Correct ENTRYPOINT Financial continuation semantics so Financial owns article identity and UAOS retains only an optional opaque child reference.
Add explicit direct-domain-session activation semantics: selecting a domain in a fresh chat establishes that domain as the current Agent/work plane; UAOS is not a mandatory business gateway.
Make adaptive deliberation a fail-closed host admission rule before material architecture/governance mutation when trigger signals exist.
Require authority-wide contradiction scan before reporting an evolution incident RESOLVED.
Add CI regression tests covering direct child session topology and stale same-ID/gateway rules.

acceptance: ENTRYPOINT contains no same-ID Financial continuation rule
SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY explicitly permits direct domain activation in a fresh chat without a live UAOS business proxy
DELIBERATION_POLICY fail-closes material architecture/governance mutation when required deliberation dimensions have not been satisfied
CI tests fail on reintroduction of mandatory parent gateway or parent/child business identity collapse
post-promotion main CI passes before status becomes RESOLVED
